title: Policy-Verified Self-Training: Learning Agent Compliance from Verifiable Policy Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.19372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Runtime policy verifiers can prevent agents from executing disallowed actions, but their decisions are typically used only for enforcement and discarded afterward. We ask whether these decisions can instead become verifiable policy rewards for training the agents they guard. We introduce Policy-Verified Self-Training (PVST), a post-training paradigm in which an agent generates its own interaction trajectories and an executable policy verifier, here a deterministic gate compiled from a written policy, evaluates whether each action complies. Compliant trajectories are reinforced, and violations become negatives for preference optimization; beyond the gate and the benchmark's task-success signal, PVST needs no stronger teacher model, no human preference labels and no attack-specific supervision, although rollouts are collected in the benchmark's attacked environment. translated_title: 策略验证自训练：从可验证策略奖励中学习智能体合规性
translated_abstract: 运行时策略验证器可以阻止智能体执行不被允许的操作，但其决策通常仅用于执行管控，随后便被丢弃。我们探究这些决策能否转而成为可验证的策略奖励，用于训练它们所守护的智能体。我们提出了策略验证自训练，这是一种后训练范式，其中智能体生成自身的交互轨迹，而一个可执行的策略验证器——此处为从书面策略编译而来的确定性门控——评估每个操作是否合规。合规轨迹被强化，违规则成为偏好优化的负样本；除了该门控和基准测试的任务成功信号外，PVST不需要更强的教师模型、不需要人工偏好标签、也不需要针对特定攻击的监督，尽管轨迹采样是在基准测试的受攻击环境中收集的。在提示注入下留出的AgentDojo任务上，策略验证偏
tldr: 提出策略验证自训练（PVST）范式，将运行时策略验证器的决策转化为可验证的策略奖励，通过强化合规轨迹、以违规作为偏好优化的负样本，无需更强教师模型、人工偏好标签或攻击特定监督即可训练智能体的策略合规性。
en_tdlr: PVST repurposes runtime policy verifier decisions as verifiable policy rewards, training agent compliance by reinforcing compliant trajectories and using violations as negatives for preference optimization—without stronger teacher models, human preference labels, or attack-specific supervision.
